entities.name: Payment Term
entities.description:
Extract the standard payment term keyword from the document — one of: BY PAYMENT, BY ACCEPTANCE, BY DEF PAYMENT, BY MIXED PYMT, BY NEGOTIATION. These indicate how and when payment is made under a Letter of Credit or trade transaction. Extract only the exact term (e.g., 'BY PAYMENT'), not the surrounding conditions or dates.

Reference meanings for clarity:

• BY PAYMENT = 'At Sight' = Immediate payment when compliant documents are presented.
  Equivalent to: Payment at sight
  When paid: Upon presentation of documents

• BY ACCEPTANCE = 'Acceptance' = Payment upon acceptance of a time draft.
  Equivalent to: Usance credit with acceptance
  When paid: At maturity date after draft acceptance

• BY DEF PAYMENT = 'Deferred Payment' = Payment at a future date without draft.
  Equivalent to: Deferred payment undertaking
  When paid: On predetermined future date

• BY NEGOTIATION = 'Negotiation' = Any bank can purchase the beneficiary's documents.
  Equivalent to: Freely negotiable credit
  When paid: When the negotiating bank purchases documents

• BY MIXED PYMT = 'Mixed Payment' = Combination of multiple payment methods.
  Equivalent to: Split payment terms
  When paid: According to mixed schedule (requires Field 42M)

Key Extraction Rules:
- 'At Sight' always maps to 'BY PAYMENT'.
- 'Deferred Payment' maps to 'BY DEF PAYMENT' (requires Field 42P).
- 'Acceptance' maps to 'BY ACCEPTANCE' (requires draft acceptance).
- 'Negotiation' maps to 'BY NEGOTIATION' (available with any bank).
- Mixed terms map to 'BY MIXED PYMT' (requires Field 42M).
